name: the-crawler
title: TheCrawler — AI-ready scraper with LLM-powered structured extraction
description: Web scraper + LLM-powered structured extraction in one actor. Crawl + parse + extract typed JSON via any OpenAI-compatible LLM (llama.cpp, vLLM, LM Studio, Ollama, OpenAI). Adaptive Cheerio→Playwright (saves cost on static sites). Out-of-box extractors: JSON-LD, microdata, commerce data (price/SKU/rating), forms, 16 analytics trackers, hreflang, redirect chain. Heading-aware RAG chunking. Structured errors (errorType + retryable, agent-friendly). UA rotation + anti-bot challenge detection. PDF + DOCX. Open source (AGPL-3.0).
